description: This file defines the JobSpecificationAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to a database table, representing attachments for job specifications, including fields like filename, type, size, content, and its association with a JobTitle.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a job specification attachment, including file metadata and relationship to JobTitle.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attached file.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, either as a string or resource.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this attachment.
